Well...It looks like this thing won't be able to\nfly for a while...
It seems like you won't be able to leave the\nmainland of Toram for a while...
Hm...while the ark is being repaired, we have no\nchoice but to make it our base. We have to make do\nwith it while we explore the mainland of Toram...
We never know what might happen here.\nStay alert, everyone!
I think it's a good idea to split up and look for\nyour kin and allies first here...
Okay guys, spread out!\nCome back here if you feel that you're in danger,\ngot it?
So what's your plan?
I'll go look for clues to the royal dragon cocoon\nwith this adventurer. Who knows, we might find\nother treasures too out there.
You have decided to go with Muti to find the\nEumanos living on the mainland first...
Okay, go and come back safely. As I said earlier,\ncome back when you feel that you're in danger,\nokay?
Aye? Everyone's already left?
Yeah.
Aye~, I wanted to go too~...
Don't be sulky! Eventually we'll need to involve\nyou to explore some things too. Until then, stay\nhere and watch the ark with me.
Aye~...
Aye, did you meet my Lixi friends?
Ah~...Many things happened and I completely forgot\nabout that. Besides, there weren't any Lixis in\nthe place we went to anyway...
Aye~, really?\nWhere can we find them?
Oh, you're back.\nNo one is injured, right?
Oh my?!\nYour wound is quite serious! Are you all right?\nLet me patch you up, come here...
What about you, are you okay?\nYou don't look very good...
...I see, so the Eumanos you guys helped before\nturned out to be Coenubias...It must have been a\npainful experience for you.
You should come here too. After patching him up,\nI'll make you Diel's special drink that can cheer\nyou up…
Will you guys be all right?
Yes~. We really wanna take a rest too, but...
You tell her that you have to go meet Mare and Aga\nas soon as possible.
Oh right, I forgot that you still need to help the\nRanas on the mainland.
You should go meet them as soon as possible then.\nDo you know where to meet them?
They said they would come through the waterway and\nwait for us by the waterside...But where is\nthat???
Aye! I know where it is!\nIf you head west, you'll find a big puddle!
Really?!\nHow come you know about it?
Anono~, I told you so many times not to wander off\non your own, but you still did it~!
Aye?!\nAaaahhh, help me~!!
W-well, I think we know where to go now.\nThanks, Anono!
Aaaah~!\nPelulu~!\nYou heartless girl~!!
Oh, you're back.\nThe ark has been fixed and now it can fly again!
I'd like to go back to Erva Tronc to report this\nto Kinda. Is it okay?
It should be fine.\nWe'll do some research while waiting for\nthe Eumano to come here!
Lady Kunon, can we stop by Aqua Gota on the way?
I'd like to report our agreement with the Ranas on\nthe mainland, but returning through the waterway\nagainst the current would take too long.
Y-yeah, sure we can go to Aqua Gota, but...
You guys will need a lot of water to survive on\nthis ark...
Yeah...But since we wanna return to Aqua Gota as\nsoon as possible, we won't ask for much.
We'll have to make do with a wooden tub that is\nbig enough for both of us and just enough water to\nkeep us from drying out...
Hmm...I think it can still fly even with a tub\nthat size plus the water that goes in it...\nOkay, let's get it ready quickly and go!
You and Pelulu, please gather the materials for\nthe tub. The rest, please prepare to bring the\nwater to fill the tub!
Okay!!
Ohh! Thank you...\nThe materials we need are all here!
Thanks. Now we can make the tub.
Alright! Let's assemble the tub inside the ark!\nYou guys should help too.
Anono! Are you sure you don't wanna stay on the\nark?
Aye! Anono wants to go look for friends!
I'll join them to find the royal dragon cocoon\ntoo! Muti, say hi to the other weredragons for me!
Okay!!
Thanks for all your help!
I believe there are still many dangers out there.\nPlease be safe!
Off we go then! Don't do anything reckless, kay!!
Alright then, shall we get going too?
First, we'll go gather some information related to\nyour friends, the Lixis!
Aye, my friends, my friends!!
